method_name: Query2doc: expansão por pseudodocumento gerado por LLM + BM25
advantage_hypothesis: recall barato: reduz desencontro de vocabulário com ~1 chamada de LLM gratuita por consulta (H5)
code_note: no official repository; implemented from the paper over github.com/xhluca/bm25s (frozen M1 configuration)
implementation: bm25s lucene (M1 frozen) + NVIDIA API Catalog chat completions

api.note: OpenRouter nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free was tried first and hit the free-model cap of 50 requests/day; its 54 expansions were discarded so every M2 number comes from one endpoint

deviation_from_reference: Portuguese legal prompt; temperature 0 instead of sampling; few-shot exemplars from dev queries instead of MS MARCO; BM25 not retuned.

usage.note: ledger was captured before the test pass (harness bug fixed in the next commit), so it covers only the 60 dev tuning calls; the 70 test expansions were generated in the first test pass (latency_first_pass_test) and their token count was not recorded. Latency rounds after the first pass reuse cached expansions.

instruction: Escreva um trecho de jurisprudência do Tribunal de Contas da União (TCU) que trate da consulta, usando a terminologia jurídica que costuma aparecer nessas decisões. Responda apenas com o trecho, em um parágrafo, sem título nem introdução.
